top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks rest on one concrete idea, Katori's magic-wavelength trapping, and its realization at the 10^-18 level has been reproduced independently in Sr, Yb and Hg by several laboratories. It already touches nature through millimetre-scale gravitational redshift and limits on drifting constants. The credit to Katori and Ye is clean, and a citation on invention and realization does not depend on redefining the second. The overlap with the 2005 and 2012 prizes and the open first-demonstration priority questions are real but do not outweigh a settled, well-attributed discovery, so I prefer an award to no award.
